ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: This course offers a special opportunity to conduct hands-on research on African art objects in the Krannert Art Museum. A goal of this research-intensive class is to develop comprehensive object files for the museumøs permanent collection. Accordingly, the course will require extensive research and library work. Attendance and class participation is critical. There will be course readings and class discussions as well as individual and group research projects and presentations. Prior knowledge of African art is not necessary, but recommended.
